statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (j : ℕ) : (j + 1) * Matrix.rank A ≤ j * Fintype.card ι + Matrix.rank (A ^ (j + 1))
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) (j : ℕ), (j + 1) * Matrix.rank A ≤ j * Fintype.card ι + Matrix.rank (A ^ (j + 1))
informal: Iterated Sylvester rank inequality for matrix powers: (j+1) * rank A ≤ j * n + rank (A^(j+1)) for an n×n matrix over a field. Promoted from Mathlib2.bld_nilpotent_rank_bound_aux1.
